label: Cultured cream
comment: Cream soured once, by the same lactic cultures, into what is one product under many names, told apart by little more than how much fat it has: each hung under the ruler at what it typically has.

about.text: Cream soured with lactic acid bacteria, which thicken it and give it its tang. It is one product under many names, from Saure Sahne to crème fraîche, told apart by little more than how much fat the cream has.

sources.text: The photograph, its author and its licence, from its page.

facts.v: Uniform, fairly viscous, mild and slightly acidic
